rule: codes are stable across minor versions; a new check gets a new code; a code is never reused or renumbered; messages are not part of the contract; reserved codes are never emitted
layer_rule: A finding's layer is the letter of its code. A validation step may emit another layer's code (decoding emits S016; the S pass emits D002). The first rejecting layer of an input is the earliest letter, in its kind's pipeline order, among its error findings. J and V findings stop later layers.

layers.J: strict JSON parse (stdlib json with hooks); runs on every input; a J finding stops later layers
layers.V: version gate: reads format and profile ids and selects the schemas; a V finding stops later layers
layers.H: the vendored HIF schema hif_schema_v0.1.0.json (blob e2105bb), unchanged; HIF inputs only
layers.R: role-convention 1.0.0 (four rules), no khg requirements; HIF inputs, alone or inside the profile
layers.P: the khg-hif profile of HIF, 1.0.0 and 1.1.0: khg-hif-1.0.0.schema.json (allOf the vendored schema) plus Python checks
layers.D: decoding (HIF to C1), cross-record, container, history and store rules (Python)
layers.C: the C1 record schema khg-record-1.0.0.schema.json (draft-07, x-khg-code annotations, if/then dispatch)
layers.S: one record against its relation-type schema (Python)
layers.M: relation-type schema documents: khg-relation-schema-1.1.0 (it reads 1.0.x too) plus Python checks
layers.Q: C3 queue files: khg-queue-1.0.0 plus the state fold, key recomputation and replay (Python); 1.1: a C or S error on a rejected item that its lint entry recorded is info (the recorded reading); Q013 is a check of the linter only
layers.I: C4 items: khg-c4-items-0.2.0.schema.json (draft-07; it reads 0.1.x too) plus the memory-gold check, by the rules of the file's stamp
layers.L: lint findings; never make a file invalid (v1 ships only L008, the store's possible-overlap warning)
layers.F: migration report entries (v1: the v0-sample migration)

pipelines.hif: J V H R P D C S (D first runs as decoding; the cross-record D checks run after S)
pipelines.queue: J V Q C S D (C and S on payloads; S003 is a warning on candidates; a C or S error that a rejected item's lint entry recorded is info)
pipelines.c4: J V I (embedded C1 records and values report C and S findings nested under I003)
